description: K₅NaP₃(HO₄)₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. There are five inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to one H and seven O atoms. The K-H bond length is 2.88 Å. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.84-3.02 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 11-coordinate geometry to two equivalent H and nine O atoms. There is one shorter (2.79 Å) and one longer (2.97 Å) K-H bond length. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.89-3.17 Å. In the third K site, K is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.58-2.85 Å. In the fourth K site, K is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to one H and eight O atoms. The K-H bond length is 2.87 Å. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.72-3.27 Å. In the fifth K site, K is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to one H and eight O atoms. The K-H bond length is 2.78 Å. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.76-3.29 Å. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.59 Å. There are three inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-32°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.64 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-62°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.64 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.65 Å. There are three inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one K and two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.02 Å) and one longer (1.59 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent K and two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.03 Å) and one longer (1.55 Å) H-O bond length. In the third H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two K and two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.01 Å) and one longer (1.65 Å) H-O bond length. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two K, one P, and one H atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three K, one Na, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four K, one Na, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to four K, one Na, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, one P, and one H atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three K, one Na, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to four K, one P, and one H atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two K, one Na, one P, and one H atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two K, one P, and one H atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to four K and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to three K, one P, and one H atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to four K and one P atom.
